newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso gains sharply, closing at 1,022.00.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso gains sharply, closing at 1,022.00.

text.p: Colombia's peso jumped 8.8 pesos against the dollar to close at 1,022.00, its highest since February 6, interbank dealers said.
They said the peso's sharp move upward was fueled by a flood of dollar sales by coffee and oil exporters, including state oil company Ecopetrol, and new foreign investment flows.
Dealers reported a trickling of demand for dollars by importers and state-run banks and financial institutions, but they said it was far too little to stem the peso's surge forward.
The peso traded in a wide 1,030.75-to-1,020.50 range and dealers reported an above-average total of 342 trades for a total of $119.5 million.
